rationale: C06 is an exceptionally close predecessor: both are unpublished executive orders titled as exemptions of a named individual from compulsory retirement for age, with only the individual’s name changed. This strongly indicates reuse of the same language and individualized exemption machinery. C25 is nearly as strong but later than C06 and less proximate in the apparent sequence; C09 is only a weaker personnel-order analogue.
